Helena accepts the command with a curt, decisive nod. There is no room for argument when the calculus has been made clear. She moves instantly to her tactical station and begins inputting the override sequence—a procedure that requires bypassing multiple layers of safety protocols due to Node Three's unstable state.

"Initiating isolation sequence," she reports, her voice regaining some of its rigid control despite the mounting pressure. "This will force a temporary reduction in the EMDF field efficiency and severely stress the primary containment buffer."

The effect is instantaneous and violent. The intense rhythmic thrumming of Jora’s EMDF field falters, the controlled pulse breaking down into a ragged, stuttering vibration. A high-pitched, grinding sound echoes through Command Level One as the localized dampening field momentarily loses its cohesive power.

CONTAINMENT INTEGRITY WARNING

The holographic projection of Node Three reacts to the power loss. The shimmering blue energy containment field—the fragile bubble holding back the dimensional shear—flickers wildly, dimming rapidly as its core input is choked off. Instead of stabilizing, the Entity responds to the abrupt interruption. The fractal geometry visible in Node Three’s viewport doesn't collapse—it snaps inward, accelerating its integration into the surrounding station architecture like a predatory reflex. "It's reacting," Ren whispers, staring at her console, the color draining from her face in stark relief against the red glow of the alerts.

The immediate threat is no longer simply an environmental breach, but architectural infection. Jora Ward shifts her posture, moving toward the main descent shaft entrance, ready for deployment, as the fractal patterns accelerate across the deck plating.
